Let a, b, k, and n denote constants, and consider the exponential functions e^x (in blue), ae^{kx} (in green), and be^{nx} (in red) whose graphs are each labeled on the axes below. Which of the following statements about the values of the constants a, b, k, and n are true? Select all true statements and submit your answers
b > 1
a > 1
a \lt 1
a \lt b
k > 1
0 \lt n \lt 1
b \lt 1
n > 1
a > b
b = 1
n \lt 0
k \lt 0
0 \lt k \lt 1
a=1
a = b

static.solution:
SOLUTION
Since the graphs of a e^{kx} and b e^{nx} have the same vertical intercept, we know a=b.
Since their common intercept is above the vertical intercept of e^{x}, we know both a >1 and b>1.
Since a e^{kx} increases as x increases, we know k>0. But a e^{kx} increases more slowly than e^{x}, so 0\lt k\lt 1.
Since b e^{nx} decreases as x increases, we know n \lt 0.
All other statements are false.
